## Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(performance)
library(patchwork)
```

## Data Wrangling
```{r}
## For Shoot Count
tables_weekly <- read_xlsx("Water Tables/DataFiles/watertables_4_22_updated_Capstone Data.xlsx", sheet = "Cleaned Water tables")
tables_weekly$Date <- as.Date(tables_weekly$Date)

clean_tables <- tables_weekly %>% 
  separate(`Plug ID`, into = c("Transplant", "plot"), sep = "\\.") %>% 
  select("Date", "Transplant", "plot", "Shoot count")

before_after <- clean_tables%>% 
  filter(Date %in% c("2026-02-28", "2026-04-18"))

## For Blade Length

#All of the Gones, dead, etc. were changed to be NA
blades_NAs <- read_xlsx("Water Tables/DataFiles/watertables_4_22_updated_Capstone Data.xlsx", sheet = "Cleaned Water tables (NAs)")
tables_weekly$Date <- as.Date(tables_weekly$Date)

blades_NAs_clean <- blades_NAs %>% 
  separate(`Plug ID`, into = c("Transplant", "plot"), sep = "\\.", remove = FALSE) %>% 
  select("Date", "Transplant", "plot", "Plug ID", "Blade length A (cm)":"Blade length C (cm)")
blades_NAs_clean$`Blade length A (cm)` <- as.numeric(blades_NAs_clean$`Blade length A (cm)`)
blades_NAs_clean$`Blade length B (cm)` <- as.numeric(blades_NAs_clean$`Blade length B (cm)`)
blades_NAs_clean$`Blade length C (cm)` <- as.numeric(blades_NAs_clean$`Blade length C (cm)`)

#All of the Gones, dead, etc. were changed to be 0
blades_0s <- read_xlsx("Water Tables/DataFiles/watertables_4_22_updated_Capstone Data.xlsx", sheet = "Cleaned Water tables (0s)")
tables_weekly$Date <- as.Date(tables_weekly$Date)

blades_0s_clean <- blades_0s %>% 
  separate(`Plug ID`, into = c("Transplant", "plot"), sep = "\\.", remove = FALSE) %>% 
  select("Date", "Transplant", "plot", "Plug ID", "Blade length A (cm)":"Blade length C (cm)")

blades_0s_clean$`Blade length A (cm)` <- as.numeric(blades_0s_clean$`Blade length A (cm)`)
blades_0s_clean$`Blade length B (cm)` <- as.numeric(blades_0s_clean$`Blade length B (cm)`)
blades_0s_clean$`Blade length C (cm)` <- as.numeric(blades_0s_clean$`Blade length C (cm)`)

                                                    



```

## Data Visualization
```{r}
## Shoot Count

# Over whole 6 weeks
ggplot(clean_tables, aes(Transplant, `Shoot count`)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue")

ggplot(before_after, aes(Transplant, `Shoot count`, fill = as.factor(Date))) +
  geom_boxplot()

#Subtracting last day from first day
sub <- before_after %>% 
  select(Date, Transplant, `plot`, `Shoot count`) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
                    names_from = Date,
                    values_from = `Shoot count`) %>% 
  mutate(subtracted = `2026-04-18` - `2026-02-28`)

ggplot(sub, aes(Transplant, subtracted)) +
  geom_point()

## Blade Length

# Weekly growth rate (week 2-week1, week3-week2 etc.)
blades_0s_clean$weekly_growth_A <- ave(blades_0s_clean$`Blade length A (cm)`, blades_0s_clean$`Plug ID`, FUN = function(x) c(NA, diff(x)))

blades_NAs_clean$weekly_growth_A <- ave(blades_NAs_clean$`Blade length A (cm)`, blades_NAs_clean$`Plug ID`, FUN = function(x) c(NA, diff(x)))

blades_0s_clean$weekly_growth_B <- ave(blades_0s_clean$`Blade length B (cm)`, blades_0s_clean$`Plug ID`, FUN = function(x) c(NA, diff(x)))

blades_NAs_clean$weekly_growth_B <- ave(blades_NAs_clean$`Blade length B (cm)`, blades_NAs_clean$`Plug ID`, FUN = function(x) c(NA, diff(x)))

blades_0s_clean$weekly_growth_C <- ave(blades_0s_clean$`Blade length C (cm)`, blades_0s_clean$`Plug ID`, FUN = function(x) c(NA, diff(x)))

blades_NAs_clean$weekly_growth_C <- ave(blades_NAs_clean$`Blade length C (cm)`, blades_NAs_clean$`Plug ID`, FUN = function(x) c(NA, diff(x)))

#Weekly Growth rate over time 0s

graph <- function(df, blade, title){
  ggplot({{df}}, aes(Date, {{blade}}, color = `Plug ID`))+
  geom_point(aes(shape = Transplant))+
  geom_line(aes(group = `Plug ID`), alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Transplant, axis.labels = )+
  labs(title = {{title}})+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
}

a <- graph(blades_0s_clean, weekly_growth_A, "Blades 0s")
b <- graph(blades_0s_clean, weekly_growth_B, "Blades 0s")
c <- graph(blades_0s_clean, weekly_growth_C, "Blades 0s")
a/b/c

#Weekly Growth rate over time NAs

bn <- graph(blades_NAs_clean, weekly_growth_B, "Blades NAs")
cn <- graph(blades_NAs_clean, weekly_growth_C, "Blades NAs")
an/bn/cn

# A/B/C






# calculate avg blade length exclusive of zeros 
# calc avg growth rate between time points 
# plot point with mean and confidence interval
# x axis labels (range of dates)

long_NA <- blades_NAs_clean %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    names_to = "Blade",
    values_to = "value",
    cols = c("Blade length A (cm)", "Blade length B (cm)", "Blade length C (cm)")
  )

avgblade <- long_NA %>% 
  group_by(Date, Transplant) %>% # Average blade length by transplant 
  summarize(
    avg_length = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SEM_ = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_low = avg_length - 1.96*SEM_, 
    CI_high = avg_length + 1.96*SEM_
  )

d <- ggplot(avgblade, aes(Date, avg_length))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~Transplant,labeller = labeller(
    Transplant = c(
      "B" = "Bucket",
      "PB" = "Pot and Bag",
      "PP" = "Peat Pot")))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
                width = .2,
                position = position_dodge(.9))+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30))
  
avgblade$weekly_growthrate <- ave(avgblade$avg_length, avgblade$Transplant, FUN = function(x) c(NA, diff(x)))

avgblade$CI_l <- avgblade$weekly_growthrate - 1.96*sd(avgblade$weekly_growthrate, na.rm = TRUE) 
avgblade$CI_h <- avgblade$weekly_growthrate + 1.96*sd(avgblade$weekly_growthrate, na.rm = TRUE) 

avgblade <- avgblade %>% 
  filter(Date >= as.Date("2026-03-07") &
         Date <= as.Date("2026-04-18"))

f<-ggplot(avgblade, aes(Date, weekly_growthrate, color = Transplant))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~Transplant,labeller = labeller(
    Transplant = c(
      "B" = "Bucket",
      "PB" = "Pot and Bag",
      "PP" = "Peat Pot")))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_l, ymax = CI_h),
                width = .2,
                position = position_dodge(.9))+
    scale_x_date(
    breaks = unique(avgblade$Date),  # tick at EVERY point
    labels = function(x) {
      week_num <- as.integer((as.Date(x) - min(avgblade$Date)) / 7) + 1
      paste("week", week_num, "to week", week_num + 1)
    })+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30))
#change to cm/day by dividing by 7
d/f

# with 3 plugs
avgblade_plug <- long_NA %>% 
  group_by(Date, Transplant, `Plug ID`) %>% # Average blade length by transplant 
  summarize(
    avg_length = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SEM_ = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_low = avg_length - 1.96*SEM_,

  )

avgblade_plug$weekly_growthrate <- ave(avgblade_plug$avg_length, avgblade_plug$Transplant, FUN = function(x) c(NA, diff(x)))

avgblade_plug$CI_l <- avgblade_plug$weekly_growthrate - 1.96*sd(avgblade_plug$weekly_growthrate, na.rm = TRUE) 
avgblade_plug$CI_h <- avgblade_plug$weekly_growthrate + 1.96*sd(avgblade_plug$weekly_growthrate, na.rm = TRUE) 

avgblade_plug <- avgblade_plug %>% 
  filter(Date >= as.Date("2026-03-07") &

ggplot(avgblade_plug, aes(Date, weekly_growthrate, color = Transplant, group = `Plug ID`))+

  facet_wrap(~Transplant,labeller = labeller(

      "B" = "Bucket",
      "PB" = "Pot and Bag",

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_l, ymax = CI_h),
                width = .2,
                position = position_dodge(.9))+
```

### Stats
```{r}
## Shoot Counts

#Poisson Regression All weeks shoot count & transplant
shoot_pois<- glm(`Shoot count` ~ Transplant, data = clean_tables, family = "poisson")

summary(shoot_pois)

check_model(shoot_pois)
check_overdispersion(shoot_pois)

## Subtracted data - before and after experiment
bashoot_pois<- glm(subtracted ~ Transplant, data = sub)

summary(bashoot_pois) 

check_model(bashoot_pois)
check_overdispersion(bashoot_pois)
```

## Graphing
```{r}
#***Shoot Count by date***
ggplot(clean_tables, aes(Date, `Shoot count`, color = Transplant)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = factor(plot))) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(Transplant, plot)), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_discrete(guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "B" = "dodgerblue",
    "PB" = "gray42",
    "PP" = "darkgreen"), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~Transplant, labeller = labeller(
    Transplant = c(
      "B" = "Bucket",
      "PB" = "Pot and Bag",
      "PP" = "Peat Pot"
    )
  )) +
  scale_shape_discrete(name = "Plug ID", labels = c(
    "1" = "Plug 1",
    "2" = "Plug 2",
    "3" = "Plug 3"
  )) +
  ylab("Shoot Count")+
  scale_x_date(breaks = unique(clean_tables$Date),
               date_labels = "%m/%d") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 18, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17)
  )


#***Raw data blade length through time *** change the points to x for dead 
ggplot(long, aes(Date, value, color = Transplant, group = paste(long$Blade, long$Plugid)))+
  geom_line(aes(color = Transplant)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Transplant)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "B" = "dodgerblue",
    "PB" = "gray42",
    "PP" = "darkgreen"
  )) +
  geom_point(data = subset(long, value == 0), aes(Date, value), color = "white", size = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = subset(long, value == 0), aes(Date, value), color = "white", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = subset(long, value == 0),aes(Date, value),
    shape = 4,color = "red", size = 3,inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = subset(long, value == 0), aes(Date, value), color = "red", inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Transplant, labeller = labeller(
    Transplant = c(
      "B" = "Bucket",
      "PB" = "Pot and Bag",
      "PP" = "Peat Pot")))+
  ylab("Blade Length")+
  scale_x_date(
    limits = as.Date(c("2026-02-28", NA)),
    breaks = seq(as.Date("2026-02-28"), by = "1 week", length.out = 12), date_labels = "%m/%d")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 17, size = 13),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17)
  )

```

```{r}
             breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
             labels = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))

ggplot(clean_tables, aes(Transplant, `Shoot count`, fill = as.factor(Transplant))) +

  annotate("text", x = 1:3, y = max(clean_tables$`Shoot count`) + 1, label = stars)+
```
